messages:
Tori: quick follow-up from the postmortem 7 re: DR and regional failover. i sketched a compact checklist and owner map for a focused dry-run next Thu 08:30 PT. please claim and add estimates.
Evan: i'll own multi-region routing checks and the pre-game route-diff job. planning: BGP local-pref verification, prefix sanity, and a traffic-steering smoke test.
Sofia: i'll take backups + snapshot manifest validation and the explicit measured-restore section for the runbook. will add time-to-restore measurement steps.
Rahul: i'll own app-side concerns: token-cache warmup timing, staggered reconnect helper, and the canary traffic policy.
Tori: proposed timeline: scripts & runbook updates by Wed EOD, rehearsal Thu 08:30 (tabletop 30m + 45m live dry-run). live failover only if dry-run passes.
Evan: recurring pattern note: we've seen route-preference flips when new prefixes are announced during autoscale events. i'll add a pre-check to compare `local-pref` ordering vs. expected baseline and fail if mismatch > 5%.
Sofia: backup note: last restore dry-run didn't capture DB wal tailing time. adding checks: ensure WAL shipping is active and measure apply rate.
Rahul: canary plan: route 4% traffic to failover region, monitor p99/p999 and error rate. abort criteria: p99 > 600ms or error > 1% sustained for 2 minutes. emitting `failover.canary.event` for observability.
Tori: owners & deliverables (short):
- Evan: routing_sanity.sh (bgp diff, prefix filters, baseline compare) + cron pre-check. due: Wed EOD.
- Sofia: restore_runbook.md updates (manifest verify, measured restore timeline, WAL checks). due: Wed EOD.
- Rahul: canary harness + reconnect-throttle script + telemetry events. due: Wed EOD.
- Tori: schedule rehearsal, coordinate DNS TTL changes, oncall overlap, and publish checklist.
Evan: thinking an automated pre-check 45m before start makes sense; i can add a cron job that runs route-diff + health probes and posts results to the runbook thread.
Sofia: pre-check snippet i'll add to the runbook:
```
# ensure latest snapshot manifest exists and checksums match
aws s3api head-object --bucket redwood-backups-prod --key snapshots/$(date -I)/manifest.json || exit 1
jq -r '.checksums[]' manifest.json | sha256sum -c - || exit 2
# verify WAL shipping and tailing on primary
pgrep -f walreceiver || exit 3
pg_replication_status | grep streaming || exit 4
```
Rahul: reconnect throttle idea: clients reconnect with jittered backoff, helper script example:
```
for i in $(seq 1 100); do
  sleep $((RANDOM % 5 + 1))
  client-reconnect --batch $i
done
```
Evan: adding a small routing smoke: announce a test prefix in staging and confirm traffic steering works end-to-end. will post results to the board.
Tori: ops-bot, please ping 45m before the rehearsal and post the short checklist 30m prior.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: rehearsal Thu 07:45 PT; checklist will post 30 minutes before start.
Sofia: also adding a rollback subsection to the runbook: explicit commands to revert DNS, demote promoted DB, and flush caches with safe backoff.
Rahul: note on caches: to avoid thundering herd, we'll rehydrate with a tokenized ramp and monitor `cache_warmup.complete` events. i'll instrument and add dashboards.
Evan: recurring incident card created: "route-preference during autoscale" -> assigned to networking for long-term fix (AS-path weighting + prefix-suppression).
Tori: final: please reply with ":white_check_mark:" to accept your task and add estimated hours on the postmortem board so SRE can staff coverage. i'll compile and move items into the tracker.
Evan: :white_check_mark: 4h estimate for scripts and pre-check job.
Sofia: :white_check_mark: 6h estimate for runbook + manifest + WAL checks.
Rahul: :white_check_mark: 5h estimate for canary + reconnect helper + dashboard events.
Tori: thanks — will send invites and link runbooks. closing this thread and exporting action items to the postmortem tracker.
